system.description:
You are a natural leader, and you founded your own Organization.

Prerequisite: Charisma 13

Effect: You become the leader of an Organization of your design. The Organization has a scale equal to one-half your Heroic Level plus your Charisma bonus and continues to grow in scale as you gain levels. You automatically begin with a +10 bonus to your Organization Score for your new Organization.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
